'''The Rolling Droids''' were a mechanical [[Band/Legends|band]] that created a genre of [[Music/Legends|music]] called [[warbat]], which played well to [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] full of appreciative [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. Their opening act was [[Danny and the Droids]]<ref name="Slugthrowers" /> and, by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]],<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> the [[F series repair droid]] [[F-22-RGKx]] enjoyed listening to the group.<ref name="Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rolling Droids were first mentioned in [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], which opened on [[July 12]], [[1989]].<ref name="Star Tours">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>
